courses.title: Python for Absolute Beginners
courses.description: A complete 22-lesson path from 'what is programming?' to building small real-world projects. No prior experience needed.
courses.overview: Python is the friendliest language to learn first, and one of the most used languages in the world - in web backends, data science, automation, and AI. This course teaches you to write, read and debug your own programs step by step. Every lesson has a short explanation, a runnable example, a quiz and a practical exercise with graduated hints. Finish the lessons and the guided projects and you will be able to write useful Python programs on your own.
prerequisites: Nothing except basic computer use - installing a program, typing, saving files

courses.title: JavaScript Fundamentals
courses.description: The language of the web: make pages interactive and build full apps.
courses.overview: JavaScript runs in every browser and is the entry point to front-end and full-stack web development.

courses.title: TypeScript Essentials
courses.description: Add a type system on top of JavaScript to catch bugs before running code.
courses.overview: TypeScript is JavaScript plus types - it powers large modern codebases.

courses.title: HTML & CSS
courses.description: Structure and style web pages - the foundation of everything on the web.
courses.overview: HTML describes what a page contains; CSS describes how it looks and behaves on any screen size.

courses.title: C Programming
courses.description: Learn how computers really work: memory, pointers and close-to-the-metal code.
courses.overview: C is small, fast and foundational - understanding it makes every other language make more sense.

courses.title: C++
courses.description: C with modern tools: objects, the STL and high-performance programs.
courses.overview: C++ powers games, engines and performance-critical software.
outline: C++ basics and differences from C

courses.title: Java
courses.description: Object-oriented programming with a statically typed, widely-deployed language.
courses.overview: Java runs on billions of devices and is a classic way to learn rigorous object-oriented design.

courses.title: SQL & Databases
courses.description: Store, query and understand data with the language every database speaks.
courses.overview: Almost every application stores data somewhere - SQL is how you talk to it.

courses.title: Git & GitHub
courses.description: Track your code, undo mistakes and collaborate like professional developers.
courses.overview: Version control is a core professional skill - start using it from your first project.

courses.title: Data Structures & Algorithms
courses.description: Think about efficiency: choose the right structure and reason about complexity.
courses.overview: Level up from writing programs that work to writing programs that scale.
prerequisites: Comfort with Python functions and classes (the Python path covers this)
